turns.text: Look up the most recent email and change its recipient to Ivan.
turns.rephrase: I mean: find my last email and then change its recipient to Ivan.
I mean: get my latest email.
I mean: address it to Heidi.

turns.gold:
PROCEDURE retarget_last_email(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND_LAST EMAIL
UPDATE $v0 RECIPIENT={person}
RETURN $v0
END
turns.name: retarget_last_email
